title: Draft and Mock (2026)
headline: No defect was found in Theorem 1 or Corollary 2 within the stated scope. This is not a proof that they are correct.

claims.label: Theorem 1
claims.gist: Anonymous posted prices resist collusion by any pair of buyers.
claims.statement: Every anonymous posted-price mechanism is pairwise collusion-proof when buyers cannot transfer money.
claims.quantifiers: for every number of buyers and goods

result.summary: No profitable pairwise deviation in any mechanism checked.
result.search_scope: All posted-price mechanisms with up to four buyers and three goods on a price grid; every pair and joint deviation.
result.limits: Side payments are outside the claim, as stated in the paper.

vor_check.detail: Statement, definitions and the decisive step checked on rendered pages of the published version.

reproduction.detail: The evidence package reruns with one command (Python 3.12, standard library only).

claims.label: Corollary 2
claims.gist: The same holds when goods are offered sequentially.
claims.statement: Offering the goods one at a time at the same prices preserves pairwise collusion-proofness.

result.summary: No counterexample among the sequential versions checked.
result.search_scope: Every order of offering the goods in the mechanisms above.
result.limits: Price changes between offers are outside the search.

vor_check.detail: Statement, definitions and the decisive step checked on rendered pages of the published version.

reproduction.detail: The evidence package reruns with one command (Python 3.12, standard library only).

history.label: Deep audit completed: no defect found

statements.ai_use: The search was designed with AI assistance and rerun by the researcher; the version-of-record check and every editorial decision were done by the researcher.
